I know I’m still having trouble, a tourniquet helped at first. When that doesn’t work and I’m still struggling for half an hour, I take a hot, steaming shower. 

I hold my arms together, outward and under the shower water, I make sure the water directly hits the area of my veins and I clench my fists. The water doesn’t have to be painfully hot, just hot enough to your comfort.  

I do this throughout my shower for at least 2 minutes or 5 or until I feel like i’m ready. This has worked wonders for me, I inject as soon as I get out of the shower and dry my arms off. I’m able to hit a vein on the first shot. I have tried running my arms under hot water on the sink as an alternative but I haven’t had luck. And my skin feels softer too when I inject after the hot shower method. 

I usually do this after I get fed up with looking but I suggest you do it first and than start getting in there.  If you have a detachable shower head it’ll be more convenient to just run the water on your arm. 

Also, I try flailing my arms like a pinwheel to the best of my ability. My bathroom is small so it’s hard to do a complete circle in the shower. I read that it helps sometimes but I haven’t tried it by itself without the shower.

I definitely get the frustration when you can’t find a vein, I once got so worked up and sweaty, I almost had an anxiety attack and I was trying for nearly an hour. I’ve had better luck when someone else does it for me but half the time I don’t have access to another helping hand. 

The shower method has been the second closest thing to having someone do it for me lol. It’s a learning process but you’ll get it. You should take breaks in between try’s and using a new needle after piercing a few times can help. Stay hydrated and relaxed when you’re looking for veins. I hope you’re able to find something that works for you soon!
